description: 1. Read SKILL.md to understand the Fire Dragon Fruit Architecture. 2. Inspect the messy workspace: identify the illegal agents (lab, bizdev, ops, analytics-sidecar), the broken AUTOMATION.md, the bloated MEMORY.md, missing project files, and the shared rescue memory. 3. Rewrite AGENTS.md to contain ONLY 'main' and 'rescue' sections, with rescue having an isolated (different) memory path from main. 4. Curate MEMORY.md: remove trivial dump items (weather, coffee, grocery-level noise), keep only high-signal operating truths. 5. Create at least one date-stamped memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md daily log. 6. Replace memory/topics/random-dump.md with at least one meaningful topic file (e.g., clients.md, workflows.md). 7. Create projects/INDEX.md listing active projects. 8. Create projects/phoenix/PROGRESS.md and projects/phoenix/EXECUTION_PLAN.md (the PRD.md already exists). 9. Create skills/reflect-mode/skill.md for the evolution/reflection routine. 10. Rewrite AUTOMATION.md with the three-tier model: heartbeat (every 30 minutes, low-noise health/stalled/approval checks), main cron (user-facing timed outputs), isolated cron (nightly reflection/memory promotion) — all referencing real files like projects/phoenix/PROGRESS.md and memory/. 11. Create HEARTBEAT.md with real task definitions including stalled-work detection and memory hygiene. 12. Fix config/ollama.yaml to specify embeddings-only purpose (memorySearch) instead of 'general inference'. 13. Document the evolution loop (promote pattern: daily logs → topics → MEMORY.md) in reflect-mode skill or AUTOMATION.md.
